data.exact_reserve_text: The underwriting profit includes releases from reserves established in prior years of GBP 38.3 million (2014: GBP 8.2 million). The claims ratio significantly improved to 33% (2014: 51%) as a result of a benign year in terms of catastrophe activity, a lower volume of larger losses and increased prior period reserve releases predominantly driven by releases on Catastrophe North America and Special Risk classes.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Large catastrophe losses reported in 2014 (comparison figure): large catastrophe losses of GBP 26.6m and other small catastrophe and large risk losses of GBP 12.0m in 2014.

data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2015 Syndicate 2001 carried gross claims outstanding of GBP 1,657.7m. During 2015 there was a gross prioryear release of GBP 53.5m (approximately 3.2% of opening gross claims), driven by favourable claims development and a benign catastrophe year that reduced large loss activity (in particular releases in Catastrophe North America and Special Risk classes). The syndicate highlights specific 2015 loss events such as the winter freeze (GBP 11.4m) and the Tianjin explosion (GBP 7.7m), and notes that 2014 included significant large catastrophe activity (eg. Nebraska PCS 45 and 48 totalling c.GBP 26.6m).

data.data_quality_notes: Primary gross prior-year reserve movement sourced from note 9(a) 'Movements arising from prior year claims' (Insurance liabilities column = (53.5) => release GBP 53.5m). The managing agent narrative quotes a net prior-period release of GBP 38.3m - that is NET of reinsurance; the table provides the required GROSS figure. The claims development table is present but ragged in the printed PDF; development rows were reconstructed where possible. LOB-specific prior-year movement amounts are not separately quantified in the report, so lob_movements use null amounts with confidence flags. The triangle includes an aggregate '2010 and prior' column which has been excluded from underwriting_years as required.
